question: Simplify: [(4x - 5y)² + 80xy​] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

(4x − 5y)² = 16x² − 40xy + 25y²

Add 80xy ⇒ 16x² + 40xy + 25y²

This becomes (4x + 5y)²

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[(4x − 5y)² + 80xy] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identities

**Calculation:**

⇒ [(4x − 5y)² + 80xy] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]

⇒ [16x² − 40xy + 25y² + 80xy] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]

⇒ [16x² + 40xy + 25y²] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]

⇒ [(4x + 5y)²] ÷ [(4x + 5y)²]

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Order: Brackets → Orders → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction

Important Identity

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

Simplification Trick

Try converting numerator into denominator form

Cancellation

Same terms in numerator and denominator cancel out
